title: ASU Taiwanese International Student Association
content_html:
The ASU Taiwanese International Student Association (TISA), known in Chinese as 亞利桑那州立大學台灣國際學生會, is a student organization at Arizona State University in Tempe, Arizona. It is listed as a member organization of ASU’s Coalition of International Students, an official university-recognized grouping of international student orgs hosted on the ASU Educational Outreach and Student Services website. TISA is distinct from the broader TSA at ASU and explicitly positions itself as a community for Taiwanese international students.

The organization’s Facebook page, operating under the handle @TISAASU, describes its purpose as welcoming anyone interested in Taiwanese culture or looking for “a home away from home.” The page’s most recent publicly visible post dates to September 2022, when the organization announced the close of a sign-up form for a fall semester event and encouraged students to look out for upcoming activities. No dedicated website or Instagram account was found in searches conducted for this record.
